reform_contract._comment: W1's runner (policyengine.py#577); its pass also needs policyengine-uk#2305 and policyengine.py#575, so certified 2.125.1 fails the dated cases by design.

tool._comment: W3's aggregate-impact tool, pinned so both pairs use the same definitions (draft policyengine-uk#2335). Move the pin to the merged commit when it lands.

reform_responsiveness._comment: Plan invariant 'Reform responsiveness' (11 Oct 2026): each standard reform must move the government balance in the expected direction by a non-trivial amount, or the candidate fails. The standard set is the metrics tool's own reform list (metrics.tool.reforms_path, whose expected impacts come from real runs on the certified pair) plus additional_reforms. A reform passes when it runs and, in every horizon year, its change in gov_balance has the sign of expected_impact and is at least floor_gbp in size (the tool's reform_gbp review threshold); in reference_year it must also be at least min_share_of_expected of |expected_impact|. The share is a proposal pending cos d1344.

promotion.decision: cos d1344: automatic promotion and review bounds are methodology calls; until ruled, promotion is a reviewed PR merge.
